concerns.text: T005 writes `data/processed/model_results_final.parquet` 'conforming to gamm_results.schema.yaml and output.schema.yaml', but output.schema.yaml requires `p_value` described as 'permutation-derived based on 10000 shuffles' plus `fdr_q_value` — those values are only produced in T006 (permutation + FDR). As ordered, T005 cannot emit schema-conforming permutation-derived fields; either move the output.schema.yaml-conforming write into T006 (after permutations/FDR), or state T005 emits only the gamm_results fields and T006 enriches to the output schema.

Both parallel tasks reference `DataFetchError` but neither task is assigned to define it; if T002's `stream_utils.py` expects the exception from T001's `config.py` (or vice versa) there is a hidden ordering requirement. Assign the definition to one task (T001) and note the import in T002 to keep the [P] tags genuinely parallel-safe.
